name: shrink an enclosing ellipsoid by a separating cut
mechanism: keep an ellipsoid known to contain the optimum, query a separating hyperplane at its centre, and replace it by the smallest ellipsoid containing the half that remains, so the volume shrinks by a fixed factor each step

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ellipsoid method' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: is an algorithm for solving convex optimization problems

fails_when: slow in practice despite polynomial bound
